# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Applied the remaining review amendment in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs` by updating the thermal-suppression probe's doc comment and inline note to match the rebuilt stable-baseline fixture and its current observed molt-stress relationship (`cool=0.009`, `warm=0.336`) instead of the stale pre-rebuild values. No behavioral logic changed in this pass.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspect the thermal-suppression probe for the stale review-noted comment references and confirm the only remaining follow-up is documentation-level.
2. [Completed] Patch the probe's doc comment and inline note so they describe the current stable-baseline fixture behavior instead of the obsolete `cool=1.000`, `warm=0.351` values.
3. [Completed] Re-run targeted and full shrimp probe tests to verify the comment-only amendment leaves the scenario suite green.

## Validation Evidence

- `git diff -- crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs` shows the only codebase change in this pass is the thermal-suppression comment refresh; no executable logic changed.
- `rg -n "1\\.000|0\\.351" crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs` returned no matches after the edit, confirming the stale values were removed.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes probe_thermal_suppression -- --nocapture` passed; the probe still reports `cool_molt_stress=0.009` and `warm_molt_stress=0.336` with the cool arm healthy and the warm arm heat-suppressed.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes -- --nocapture` passed; all 6 tests succeeded and the summary runner reported all 5 shrimp probes passing.

## Outstanding Risks

- The worktree still contains unrelated pre-existing modifications in `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7` and `.ralph-burning/`; they were left untouched.
- The refreshed thermal-suppression comments now cite current observed calibration values, so future retunes that materially change those metrics may require another documentation refresh.
